steps.action: Create parent and child Knowledge Folders through the library controls
steps.actual: Add folder created a root folder and a nested child under the selected parent

steps.action: Create separate draft items from two selected files
steps.actual: Two selected PDFs created two filename-titled Draft/Legal Only items in the chosen child folder, each with its own primary Document; first item opened

steps.action: Edit title and guidance, preview Markdown, and confirm persistence after reload
steps.actual: Title saved with Enter; Preview rendered a heading/list/emphasis and blurred the editor to save guidance; reload retained both

steps.action: Upload supporting paper and move the primary choice
steps.actual: Shared Upload added a supporting DOCX; Set as primary moved the choice and Open preview opened its current Version

steps.action: Create a guidance-only item with no Document and change its folder
steps.actual: New Knowledge Item created an Article with no primary Document; Markdown guidance and child Folder saved without requiring a file

steps.action: Filter by parent and Type, rename/move folders, exclude cycles, and dissolve without deleting items
steps.actual: Parent selection included descendant items; Type narrowed independently; self/descendants were absent from parent choices; rename saved and Delete folder promoted its child without losing either item or its Documents
